ImpactGrounds.description: The grounds an item's co-work setting is judged on, as the item keeps them.

new_home.description: Whether a new module, table or other home must be decided before the work is written.

nodes.description: Every graph node the change reaches, the node to change first, then what graph_impact reached.

contract.description:
The outward contract that changes on it — API, schema, wire format, policy file or documented
behaviour — or null where only its inside changes.

chat.description: The room, by chat id, where it is not this turn's own.

from_todo.description: <id>:<strand>[,<id>:<strand>] of the unfinished notes a judgement row came out of.

impact.description:
The grounds the co-work setting was weighed on, for a change to code: the graph nodes it reaches and
the outward contract that changes on each, in English.

instruction.description: The archived messages that asked for it.

judgement.description: The agent's own reason for a row nobody asked for; takes none of the conversation's parts.

message.description: The message this call acts on: the id of the person's message in this turn that asked for it. Omitted only in a turn whose every new message is the owner's, or that no person's message opened.

raised_by.description: The item whose work raised a judgement row.

reply.description: The agent's archived replies to copy.

reply_text.description: The agent's reply, where none is archived.

requester.description: Who asked, where the archive names nobody.
